modules.purpose: Retention half of decision ticket 11 Q3: signals with no binding claim are retained (never deleted) and decay exponentially in weight over time; reports pool size, age distribution, decayed state.
modules.key_functions: decay_function(path) loads+validates decay.yaml (half_life>0, 0<threshold<1), lru_cache'd; weight(age_days,path) = 0.5**(age_days/half_life); is_decayed(w,path); decayed_on(signal_date,path) computes crossing date via math.log; pin(path) returns version/params/digest; unbound_ids(overlay) = signals minus those bound via SIGNAL_BINDING_KINDS claims; pool(overlay,at,path) returns per-signal entries with age/weight/decayed/decayed_on, raises on negative age; age_distribution(entries,path) bins live pool into 5 half-life-multiple bins (0-1..4+), zero-filled; unbound_pool_artefact(...) builds a DERIVED Artefact
modules.depends_on: PACKAGE_DIR/TOOL_VERSION/verbs, artefact.Artefact/DERIVED, canon.digest_of, grades.Capabilities, model.Overlay, repo.ModelRepo, schema.SIGNAL_BINDING_KINDS

modules.purpose: Rescue half of decision ticket 11 Q3: re-attempts binding every unbound-pool entry against the *current* candidate set (e.g. after a model change adds a component), reporting rebound vs still-unbound and lead-time-to-recognition, without ever diffing history.
modules.key_functions: rebind(overlay,entry,candidates) uses signal_classify.best_match() score to refuse a rubber-stamp bind (returns None if score==0), else calls classify(); sweep(overlay,at) runs unbound_pool.pool() then rebind for every entry, returns {rebound, still_unbound}; lead_time_summary(rebound) computes min/max/mean days per_signal; retrospective_sweep_artefact(...) builds DERIVED Artefact carrying decay pin
modules.depends_on: ingest.candidates_of, model.Overlay, repo.ModelRepo, signal_classify.best_match/classify, unbound_pool.pin/pool, verbs, artefact.Artefact/DERIVED, grades.Capabilities

modules.purpose: sweep(): scheduled, unconditional execution of every scenario in every org overlay across a *list* of repositories (adapted from arckit's single-repo refresh model), with deliberately NO hash-staleness skip (to avoid selection bias in the calibration record), and per-scenario failure isolation.
modules.key_functions: sweep(repos, caps, command, at=None) iterates repos -> orgs(repo) -> overlay.scenarios, calls verbs.run() per scenario at AS_CONSUMED regime, catches VerbError/ModelError/RegimeError/SchemaError into failures list and continues, aggregates executions with forecast_bundle sha256/pins/forecast_count

modules.purpose: Proper scoring rules (Brier, log-loss) with quantisation for cross-platform reproducibility; reliability-diagram binning over a pooled forecast population; measure_discount() for the Enron-memorisation-leakage discount metric.
modules.key_functions: quantise(value) rounds to 12 significant decimal digits; _check(probability) refuses p<=0 or p>=1; brier(p,observed)=(p-outcome)**2; log_loss(p,observed)=-log(p or 1-p); score(p,observed) returns both quantised; measure_discount(enron,obscure,rule,hindsight_memorising=None,hindsight_honest=None) computes mean-loss gap(s) (enron-vs-obscure, optionally folded with hindsight-memorising-vs-honest) averaged across legs; reliability_diagram(scores,bins=10) bins by predicted probability, reports count/mean_forecast/empirical_frequency per bin (None on empty, not 0.0), every bin present including empty
modules.depends_on: stdlib math only

modules.purpose: The half that 'reads both' ground truth and detections (decision ticket 12 Q3b): scores each planted signal timely/late/missed against its actionability horizon, using near-zero (not zero) for late detections.
modules.key_functions: PlantScore(plant,detected,timely,score,reason) frozen dataclass; ScoreResult(detected_at,plant_scores,limitation) with hit_rate and mean_score properties; score(ground_truth,detections,detected_at) compares each plant's (channel,index) against the detections set, day-string comparison detected_at<=horizon for timely (TIMELY_SCORE=1.0), else LATE_SCORE=0.05, MISSED_SCORE=0.0 if never detected at that location; every ScoreResult carries planter.SHARED_PRIOR_LIMITATION verbatim
modules.depends_on: detector.Detection, planter.SHARED_PRIOR_LIMITATION/Plant

modules.purpose: SubstrateRecipe format (twin.substrate-recipe/v1: id, seed, templates, model_version, planted_signals) and the two toy generators demonstrating deterministic-vs-non-reproducible generation, establishing that regenerated substrate content must be marked AUTHORED (not DERIVED) because a real model call cannot guarantee byte-identical reproduction.

notes: This cluster forms a coherent pipeline: substrate.py/substrate_generator.py generate synthetic multi-channel corpora -> planter.py seals ground truth (with strength+horizon) -> detector.py finds candidates blind -> scorer.py grades timely/late/missed -> substrate_eval.py measures 7 fidelity dimensions and tunes the generator -> substrate_report.py packages both readings into one artefact. In parallel, ingest.py/market_signals.py run signal_classify.classify() unattended at volume over substrate lines and market price moves respectively, both explicitly ungated at entry and both grade-5-by-construction; unbound_pool.py/retrospective_sweep.py handle what signal_classify fails to bind (decay + rescue). schedule.py is the volume-forcing scheduler for the *forecast* side (twin run/scenarios), separate from ingest volume. scoring.py provides the proper scoring rules and reliability diagram used to grade forecasts elsewhere in the twin. skills.py/skill-thresholds.yaml/skill-scores.jsonl/record_skill_scores.py form the third evaluation seam that treats every heuristic (signal-classify, substrate-generator, etc.) as a non-deterministic 'skill' scored against a threshold rather than asserted correct by construction. Every heuristic module is candid in its own docstring about being a stand-in for a real model call ('ponytail:' notes), and every such note names an explicit upgrade path (swap the function body, harness/tests unchanged) -- this is a deliberate, well-documented pattern across the cluster rather than a hidden gap.
